cases.sentence: — Ты и твои сыновья не должны пить вино или другие ___, когда входите в шатер собрания, иначе вы умрете.
cases.explain: «крепкие напитки» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

cases.explain: «вечное установление» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

cases.explain: «грядущих поколений» — after the preposition «для», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: “You and your sons are not to drink wine or strong drink whenever you go into the Tent of Meeting, or you will die. This shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

cases.sentence: Ешьте его на ___, потому что оно — твоя доля и доля твоих сыновей в огненных жертвах Господу; мне было так велено.
cases.explain: «святом месте» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; for so I am commanded.

cases.sentence: Ешьте его на святом месте, потому что оно — твоя доля и доля твоих сыновей в ___ Господу; мне было так велено.
cases.explain: «огненных жертвах» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: and you shall eat it in a holy place, because it is your portion, and your sons’ portion, of the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; for so I am commanded.

cases.sentence: Ешьте их на ___; они даны тебе и твоим детям как ваша доля в жертвах примирения, приносимых израильтянами.
cases.explain: «чистом месте» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: The waved breast and the heaved thigh you shall eat in a clean place, you, and your sons, and your daughters with you: for they are given as your portion, and your sons’ portion, out of the sacrifices of the peace offerings of the children of Israel.

cases.sentence: Бедро возношения и грудину потрясания следует приносить с жиром ___, чтобы их потрясали перед Господом как приношение потрясания.
cases.explain: «огненных жертв» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The heaved thigh and the waved breast they shall bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as Yahweh has commanded.”

cases.sentence: Это будет ___ тебе и твоим детям, как повелел Господь.
cases.explain: «постоянной долей» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: The heaved thigh and the waved breast they shall bring with the offerings made by fire of the fat, to wave it for a wave offering before Yahweh. It shall be yours, and your sons’ with you, as a portion forever, as Yahweh has commanded.”

cases.sentence: — Почему вы не ели жертву за грех на ___?
cases.explain: «святом месте» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahweh?

cases.sentence: Это — ___; она была дана вам, чтобы вы сняли вину общины, совершив для них отпущение перед Господом.
cases.explain: «великая святыня» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “Why haven’t you eaten the sin offering in the place of the sanctuary, since it is most holy, and he has given it to you to bear the iniquity of the congregation, to make atonement for them before Yahweh?

cases.sentence: Раз ее кровь не внесли в святилище, вы должны были съесть жертву на ___, как я велел.
cases.explain: «святом месте» — after the preposition «на», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Behold, its blood was not brought into the inner part of the sanctuary. You certainly should have eaten it in the sanctuary, as I commanded.”
